drugs.name: Oxacillin
drugs.spectrum: Methicillin-susceptible staphylococci
drugs.limitations: No useful Gram-negative or enterococcal spectrum
drugs.resistance: mecA/mecC에 의한 PBP2a. Oxacillin은 포도알균 penicillinase에 안정하지만 PBP2a에 의한 내성을 극복하지 못한다.

drugs.name: Vancomycin
drugs.mechanism: Binds D-Ala-D-Ala and blocks cell-wall synthesis
drugs.spectrum: Gram-positive organisms
drugs.limitations: No Gram-negative activity; oral drug is not systemic therapy
drugs.resistance: vanA/vanB target replacement; VISA cell-wall thickening

drugs.name: Ceftriaxone
drugs.spectrum: Selected Enterobacterales, streptococci and other susceptible bacteria
drugs.limitations: No enterococcal or Pseudomonas activity; AmpC induction/selection concern
drugs.resistance: ESBL, AmpC, carbapenemases, altered PBPs

drugs.name: Cefepime
drugs.spectrum: Broad Gram-negative including Pseudomonas plus selected Gram-positive
drugs.limitations: No enterococcal activity
drugs.resistance: ESBL/AmpC plus porin loss, carbapenemases, PBP changes

drugs.name: Ceftazidime
drugs.spectrum: Gram-negative including Pseudomonas
drugs.limitations: Weak Gram-positive spectrum; no enterococci
drugs.resistance: ESBL, AmpC, carbapenemases, permeability/efflux

drugs.name: Meropenem
drugs.spectrum: Broad aerobic/anaerobic Gram-negative and Gram-positive
drugs.limitations: No MRSA; enterococci unreliable
drugs.resistance: Carbapenemases, porin loss plus beta-lactamase, efflux

drugs.name: Imipenem
drugs.spectrum: Broad aerobic/anaerobic spectrum
drugs.limitations: No MRSA; species-specific limitations
drugs.resistance: Carbapenemases, porin loss, efflux

drugs.name: Aztreonam
drugs.spectrum: Aerobic Gram-negative bacilli
drugs.limitations: No Gram-positive or anaerobic activity
drugs.resistance: ESBL, AmpC, serine carbapenemases; stable to metallo-beta-lactamases

drugs.name: Ciprofloxacin
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV
drugs.spectrum: Many Gram-negative and selected Gram-positive bacteria
drugs.limitations: Resistance emerges readily; exposure/site constraints
drugs.resistance: gyrA/parC mutations, qnr, efflux, reduced permeability

drugs.name: Levofloxacin
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV
drugs.spectrum: Respiratory pathogens and many Gram-negative bacteria
drugs.limitations: Resistance emerges readily; exposure/site constraints
drugs.resistance: gyrA/parC mutations, qnr, efflux

drugs.name: Ampicillin
drugs.spectrum: Enterococci, susceptible Gram-positive and selected Gram-negative
drugs.limitations: Hydrolyzed by many beta-lactamases
drugs.resistance: Beta-lactamases and altered PBPs

drugs.name: Piperacillin–tazobactam
drugs.mechanism: PBP inhibition plus inhibition of selected serine beta-lactamases
drugs.spectrum: Broad spectrum including Pseudomonas and anaerobes when susceptible
drugs.limitations: Unreliable for ESBL invasive infection; not active against MRSA
drugs.resistance: AmpC, ESBL inoculum effect, carbapenemases, porin/efflux changes

drugs.name: Linezolid
drugs.spectrum: Gram-positive organisms including MRSA and VRE
drugs.limitations: No Gram-negative activity; bacteriostatic for staphylococci/enterococci
drugs.resistance: 23S rRNA mutations, cfr/optrA/poxtA

drugs.name: Ceftazidime–avibactam
drugs.mechanism: PBP inhibition plus class A/C and some D beta-lactamase inhibition
drugs.spectrum: Selected resistant Enterobacterales and Pseudomonas
drugs.limitations: No metallo-beta-lactamase inhibition; no Gram-positive role
drugs.resistance: MBLs, KPC variants, permeability/efflux mechanisms

drugs.name: Teicoplanin
drugs.mechanism: Binds D-Ala-D-Ala and blocks cell-wall synthesis
drugs.spectrum: Gram-positive organisms
drugs.limitations: No Gram-negative activity
drugs.resistance: vanA target replacement and related mechanisms

drugs.name: Cefazolin
drugs.spectrum: MSSA, streptococci and selected Enterobacterales
drugs.limitations: No MRSA, enterococci or Pseudomonas
drugs.resistance: ESBL/AmpC, altered PBPs, beta-lactamases

drugs.name: Penicillin G
drugs.spectrum: Susceptible streptococci, enterococci and selected Gram-positive organisms
drugs.limitations: Penicillinase-producing staphylococci and most aerobic Gram-negative bacilli are resistant
drugs.resistance: blaZ and other beta-lactamases; altered PBPs

drugs.name: Amoxicillin–clavulanate
drugs.mechanism: PBP inhibition plus inhibition of susceptible beta-lactamases
drugs.spectrum: Many community Gram-positive, Gram-negative and anaerobic pathogens
drugs.limitations: No Pseudomonas; unreliable against AmpC, ESBL and carbapenemases
drugs.resistance: AmpC/ESBL/carbapenemases, inhibitor-resistant enzymes, altered PBPs

drugs.name: Ceftaroline
drugs.spectrum: MRSA, MSSA, streptococci and selected susceptible Enterobacterales
drugs.limitations: No Pseudomonas; unreliable against ESBL, AmpC and carbapenemases
drugs.resistance: PBP2a/PBP mutations and beta-lactamases in Gram-negatives

drugs.name: Daptomycin
drugs.mechanism: Calcium-dependent Gram-positive membrane insertion and depolarization
drugs.spectrum: Gram-positive bacteria including MRSA and VRE
drugs.limitations: 폐 계면활성제에 의해 불활성화되므로 폐렴에는 사용하지 않는다(non-pneumonia use only). Gram-negative 항균 활성도 없다.
drugs.resistance: mprF/liaFSR and membrane/cell-envelope adaptation

drugs.name: Clindamycin
drugs.mechanism: Binds 50S ribosome and inhibits peptide elongation
drugs.spectrum: Selected Gram-positive cocci and anaerobes
drugs.limitations: No aerobic Gram-negative activity; inducible resistance requires D-test
drugs.resistance: erm-mediated MLSB and lnu-mediated inactivation

drugs.name: Erythromycin
drugs.mechanism: Binds 50S exit tunnel and inhibits translocation
drugs.spectrum: Selected susceptible Gram-positive and atypical organisms
drugs.limitations: Poor aerobic Gram-negative coverage; resistance common
drugs.resistance: erm methylation, mef efflux, ribosomal mutations

drugs.name: Doxycycline
drugs.spectrum: Broad activity including selected Gram-positive, atypical and some Gram-negative bacteria
drugs.limitations: Species/site-specific breakpoint gaps; not reliable for Pseudomonas
drugs.resistance: tet efflux, ribosomal protection and enzymatic inactivation

drugs.name: Trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole
drugs.spectrum: Many staphylococci and Enterobacterales when susceptible
drugs.limitations: No reliable enterococcal or Pseudomonas role; site limitations
drugs.resistance: dfr and sul genes, target overproduction, permeability changes

drugs.name: Gentamicin
drugs.spectrum: Aerobic Gram-negative bacilli; synergy with cell-wall agents in selected Gram-positive infection
drugs.limitations: No anaerobic activity; enterococcal use is synergy only after high-level resistance exclusion
drugs.resistance: Aminoglycoside-modifying enzymes, 16S methylases, permeability/efflux

drugs.name: Amikacin
drugs.spectrum: Aerobic Gram-negative bacilli including some resistant isolates
drugs.limitations: No anaerobic activity; enterococcal monotherapy is ineffective
drugs.resistance: 16S methylases, modifying enzymes, permeability/efflux

drugs.name: Metronidazole
drugs.spectrum: Susceptible anaerobic bacteria and protozoa
drugs.limitations: Facultative and obligate aerobes are intrinsically outside its antibacterial spectrum
drugs.resistance: nim genes, altered reduction and DNA repair

drugs.name: Tigecycline
drugs.spectrum: Broad Gram-positive, anaerobic and selected Gram-negative activity
drugs.limitations: No Pseudomonas; low serum/urine exposure limits bloodstream and urinary use
drugs.resistance: tet(X) 효소 불활성화, AcrAB 등 유출펌프 증가. 기존 tetracycline의 전형적 ribosomal protection과 약제 특이적 efflux에는 상대적으로 덜 영향을 받는다.

reservoir.text: 사람의 장내 세균총. 내인성 감염 및 의료환경에서 접촉 전파.

records.biology: 통성혐기성 Enterobacterales. 이번 문제의 내성 phenotype은 장관외 감염 분리주로 설정했다.
records.diagnostics: Perform organism identification, phenotypic AST, and validated carbapenemase testing. The enzyme name does not replace the complete isolate susceptibility panel.
records.pearl: Interpret NDM together with the full AST: co-produced beta-lactamases and permeability mechanisms can change the phenotype, and unrelated resistance is not inferred here.

culture.text: MacConkey agar에서 lactose 발효성 분홍색 집락. 통성혐기성 성장.

virulence.text: Fimbriae와 adhesin, LPS. 병원형에 따라 capsule, enterotoxin 또는 Shiga toxin이 추가된다.

reservoir.text: 사람의 장내 세균총. 내인성 감염 및 의료환경에서 접촉 전파.

diseases.text: 방광염, 신우신염, 균혈증, 복강 감염. 일부 병원형은 장염 또는 신생아 수막염.

resistance.text: NDM metallo-beta-lactamase hydrolyzes carbapenems and most beta-lactams but not aztreonam. This fixed isolate has no co-produced enzyme that removes aztreonam activity; unrelated-drug results are authored independently.

geography.text: 전 세계에 분포. 이 기록은 특정 지역 유행주를 전제로 하지 않는다.

oxacillin.note: EUCAST v16.1의 Enterobacterales 표(p. 14)에서 oxacillin은 dash(–)이다. EUCAST Note 8은 이 조합을 치료에 부적합하며 검사·임상 사용을 피하고, 보고가 필요하면 검사 없이 R로 보고하도록 명시한다.
